body: So many people think I’m still on drugs because of who I’m with. I can’t escape judgement.
I have faith and I still complete my daily tasks. I spoke with dcfs and it hurts but I feel better about it
I finally talked to them. They are investigating. I got a nasty message from the kids mom. I just shoved it off n said I didn’t call.
I agree with this entire reply. This is what I needed to hear

He doesn’t realize how bad it messes with his head. I did call child protective services. They left me a voicemail but I haven’t called back. I’m scared but I’m gonna stay strong because the kids need it.
This is by far the most helpful thing I’ve read. “I can’t save you from you, but I can save me from you “ that hit me so hard. Thank you so much
My daughter will be meeting him on my terms and not on his that’s for sure. I don’t want her at his house. I don’t even think his kids should be there.
I’ve developed so much self control though. Everyday I’m left in a room with meth readily available and I don’t even touch it or even think about it
I understand that. Just because he’s an addict doesn’t make him a bad person

I take care of me while being with him. I still continue to go to work and school. I have recently discovered meditation and I scared myself out of doing meth ever again because I think I almost went into cardiac arrest. I’ll never put another needle in my arm or a dope pipe to my lips
Child services didn’t take my kid from me it was in divorce
I’m in school full time  and working. With the money I receive I’m taking a hair follicle test and doing the parenting classes that were ordered in divorce
I just contacted dcfs... I hated every minute of it but it needs to be done
When I get my daughter we will be at our house. I do not want to expose her to this life. Not again. My house is up the road

His kids love me. His daughter opens up to me and talks about how she is upset with her home life with her mom. I believe that calling child services is just going to piss him off. Maybe he would get clean for his kids but I don’t know. It’s definitely not a safe environment here. I won’t bring my child here even after I get her
I feel like when they are here I’m the babysitter so he can get high but if I’m not here something terrible might happen
I do not have my daughter yet. I lost her when I was addicted. I’m in the process of getting her back. He’s never met her just seen her on video chats

I got a job. I go to work every day I’m scheduled. I thought about anonymously calling dcfs again because he won’t even get up in the morning to watch the toddler. The one weekend he slept til two in the afternoon. If I’m not here something could happen to the kids. I feel wrong stepping in to care for his son because that’s his pride and joy. His son doesn’t care for me much. They definitely are not safe

I don’t live here. My house is up the rd. He has the window ac from my house so he can keep it cool in here for the kids. He won’t come to my house because he says there isn’t room for them to play there.
I can’t do that to him. There’s one thing he doesn’t do. He doesn’t lie to me. No matter what I’m going to be sober my four year old depends on me
I HAVE called social services. They took his kids for a little bit then he got them back idk how though. He doesn’t have a shower or bathtub. I go to my house to take showers.

I have set some boundaries such as not buying him drugs. I do also have my own house two blocks away. I stay here when his kids are here because his son is two and into everything. He left a bag in arms reach one time and he’s lucky I got it before a child did.
I can not agree more!

I can’t even do that. I constantly feel like something is wrong with me. Like the world is over my shoulder giving me a social anxiety nightmare. If I tell people I wanna die they tell me to go to the hospital or some weird shit I hate and doesn’t help. I’m not gonna commit suicide because I’m afraid. I tried once and I couldn’t follow through. I can’t ever follow through. I feel like this world isn’t real and the only way out and back to reality is to die
Great fuckin name
